title: Juicy Light Moroccan Taleggio Stir fry
description: A winey and light Moroccan dish featuring taleggio cheese, this stir fry is a keto friendly and adventurous meal option.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until softened.
Add the sliced bell pepper to the skillet and cook until tender.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the sliced taleggio cheese to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the cheese and vegetables.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the chicken is coated.
